seoTitle: Google Fonts Loading Checker: Find Remote Fonts and Self-Host
metaDescription: Paste HTML or CSS to find remote Google Fonts requests, the families used, and get a self-hosting plan with @font-face stubs. Free.
intro: Finds Google Fonts links, imports and preconnects in pasted source and gives a self-hosting plan.
why:
Loading fonts from fonts.googleapis.com makes each visitor's browser contact Google, which sends the IP address to a third party. Some European courts and authorities have treated this as a data protection problem, and many sites now host the font files themselves.

Paste your HTML or CSS and the tool lists each Google Fonts URL, the families and weights, and a step plan with @font-face stubs. It only sees the text you paste, so fonts loaded by scripts or plugins need a look at the Network tab.
howTo: Paste the head of your page or your CSS.
Read the list of remote URLs and families.
Download the font files, host them on your domain and add the @font-face rules.
Remove the Google links and update your CSP.

faq.a: There is no single answer. Some courts and authorities objected; others did not. Self-hosting avoids the question.

faq.q: Are the fonts free to host myself?
faq.a: Google Fonts are open source licensed, mostly under the SIL Open Font License. Check each font's licence.

faq.q: Will it find fonts loaded by JavaScript?
faq.a: No. Check the Network tab for fonts.gstatic.com.
